feature: Precon Upgrade fresh start 4/4 (addendum fresh start R2): the result as Suggested changes' lists, adds and cuts picked separately
note: Scratch-only fixtures for the audit account with PRECON_UPGRADE_ENABLED on for it (a user override). One done, seen run per STATES 'Picking adds and cuts' state, on a precon the account has no other run on, so the start screen's Your last upgrade row opens it: AdaptiveEnchantment_C18 every line picked, led by Kestia (the box Overview's alternate) so the commander pair draws above the lists; AhoyMateys_LCC one add and another pair's cut unpicked; ArcaneWizardry_C17 one cut unpicked; BuckleUp_NEC the Mystical Tutor add (the pair carrying addBracketAfter [3], the bracket-moving pick) and one cut unpicked; CavalryCharge_MOC every line unpicked. Every pair carries reason and cutReason; bracket 2 -> 3 at target 3. UPGRADE_DECK_ID is the account's box deck started from SultaiArisen_TDC (still the box, so the band shows), whose run is its Your last upgrade. No row presses Pick, Start or Apply: the picks are the seed's, and nothing spends. The By role row runs last: the grouping is remembered for the rows after it.
